seite.neuerOrdnerTitel: Create a folder at the top level
dashboard.leer: No folders on the dashboard yet. Switch on “Show on the PaperTree dashboard” in a folder's editor.
baum.leer: No folders yet. Create the first one with “+ Folder”.
menue.loeschenFrage: Delete “{name}”? The documents in Paperless stay untouched.
menue.loeschenMitKindern.one: Delete “{name}” and {anzahl} subfolder? The documents in Paperless stay untouched.
menue.loeschenMitKindern.other: Delete “{name}” and {anzahl} subfolders? The documents in Paperless stay untouched.
ordner.fehlendeReferenzen: This filter names something that no longer exists in Paperless: {was}. The folder stays — please adjust the filter.
ordner.nurNavigation: This folder is for navigation. Pick a subfolder above.
ordner.nurNavigationLeer: This folder is for navigation and has no subfolders yet.
detail.nurLesend: PaperTree is read-only – changes are made in Paperless.
pdf.fehler: The preview could not be loaded: {grund}
editor.name: Name
editor.eigenerFilterText: – the folder shows documents of its own
editor.kinderText: – plus the documents of the subfolders
editor.tief: whole subtree (off: only the level below)
editor.modusNavigation: Navigation only: the folder shows nothing but its subfolders.
editor.modusKinder: Shows the documents of the subfolders, merged.
editor.modusEigener: Shows only the documents of its own filter.
editor.modusBeides: Shows its own documents plus those of the subfolders.
editor.aufspannenHinweis: Builds the subfolders from the values that occur, instead of creating them by hand. When a new value shows up in Paperless, the subfolder appears by itself. Hand-made subfolders continue to exist alongside them.
editor.eigenstaendig: Independent – does not inherit the filter of the folders above
editor.keinKriterium: No criterion yet – the folder would show every document.
editor.rohHinweis: Taken from a link and not editable here.
editor.linkUebernehmen: Take it from a Paperless link
editor.linkHinweis: Put the search together in Paperless, copy the whole link from the address bar and paste it here.
editor.linkOhneFilter: There was no filter in that link.
editor.linkUnlesbar: That link could not be read.
editor.schichten: ({anzahl} queries, PaperTree intersects them by ID)
einstellungen.nurAdmin: The settings are reserved for administrators.
einstellungen.tagsErklaerung: An icon takes the place of the shortened name in the lists. It applies in PaperTree only; nothing changes in Paperless.
einstellungen.keinSymbol: No icon – the list shows the shortened name
einstellungen.logoErklaerung: The logo appears small in front of the name in the lists and large in the corner of the document view. PNG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP or SVG, at most 1 MB.
import.keinJson: This file does not contain valid JSON.
import.keinBaum: There is no PaperTree tree in this file.
import.frage.one: Create {anzahl} additional folder (with its subfolders) from this file? The existing tree stays unchanged.
import.frage.other: Create {anzahl} additional folders (with their subfolders) from this file? The existing tree stays unchanged.
anmeldung.hinweis: Please sign in to Paperless – PaperTree uses the same session.
fehler.dokument: The document could not be loaded: {grund}
fehler.dokumenteListe: The documents could not be loaded: {grund}
fehler.einstellungen: The settings could not be loaded: {grund}
fehler.dateiNichtLesbarTitel: The file cannot be read right now
fehler.dateiNichtLesbar: Paperless cannot reach the original file at the moment. That is the storage behind it, not the document — try again in a minute.
